title: cuda-samples exclude list
description: Samples that must not run on this project/device. Excluded samples are still listed by the cuda_samples_resource resource job (with skip: True and the reason), so the jobs generated for them appear as visible skips in the run instead of silently disappearing.

name.description: Exact sample directory name, e.g. deviceQuery

category.description: Optional samples category directory, e.g. 0_Introduction; when present the exclude only matches that category

reason.description: Why the sample is excluded; shown as the job's skip reason
